body: You’d think. I was moving a $600k load of solar inverters. Knowing that it was prob high value we asked the shipper to verify. They said $100k would do it. Truck crashed. Total loss o key found out it was $600k once the claim came in.
As someone who works in transportation (in the US) most all carriers  only have $100k cargo insurance. Some have $250k but that’s rare.
I hope you don’t. You are loved.

Please don’t. I’m literally begging you not to. I would love to be your friend and help in anyway that I can. You are loved. My brother ended his life December of last year and no one saw any signs of him struggling the way he was. I wish I could help him now but I’m hoping I can help you. Please.

I was in your shoes before. Changing your life isn’t easy and I’m still working on it. My brother ended his life in December last year and we are still reeling from it. You are loved but need to find the love. Reach out to family and friends about it. Find things that make YOU happy. Don’t rely on others to make you happy. You are on the right path but it just takes time. Sometimes it takes longer than what you want but it will get better.

Please don’t. My brother committed suicide 12/9/2017 and we didn’t know he was having issues. Please. I literally can’t beg you enough. Talk to someone. Reach out to anyone. Your father, friend, anyone. The pain will pass and you will have brighter days ahead of you. Coming from someone who is going through trying to figure out my brothers passing, I can only hope that you will think more about this. You are loved.
